title: Groundwater Conservation District Reform Act
summary: Reforms groundwater conservation district governance to increase landowner representation, limit regulatory fees, and protect the rule of capture for private landowners while maintaining conservation goals.
eastTexasImpact: Strengthens East Texas landowners' groundwater rights and limits the ability of groundwater conservation districts to impose excessive regulations or fees on rural water well owners in the Carrizo-Wilcox aquifer region.
